faq.howItWorksTitle: How to use the Font Generator?
faq.step1Desc: Type or paste any text in English, Russian, or Uzbek into the input box above.
faq.step2Desc: Browse through dozens of generated styles and add fancy emojis or gaming symbols.
faq.step3Desc: Click the Copy button and paste the result into your Instagram bio, Telegram post, TikTok bio, or gaming nickname.
faq.q1: Will these fancy fonts work across all social networks?
faq.a1: Yes! Our generator converts your text into universal Unicode characters. They are natively supported by Instagram, Telegram, TikTok, WhatsApp, Facebook, Discord, X (Twitter), and games like Free Fire, PUBG, CS, and Brawl Stars.
faq.q2: Do I need to install or download any fonts?
faq.a2: No installation is required. Everything runs in the browser using Unicode symbols, so anyone on any device or computer can see them without installing anything.
faq.q3: Does it support Uzbek, Russian, and English characters?
faq.a3: Yes, our styles and decorations support Latin, Cyrillic, and universal special symbols, frames, and accents.
faq.q4: Is Toolboxi.uz completely free to use?
faq.a4: Yes, our service is 100% free with no registration or subscriptions. You can format unlimited texts and nicknames.
faq.q5: How can I make a cool nickname for games (PUBG, Free Fire)?
faq.a5: Type your nickname, scroll to the Nicknames & Gaming category in the symbols widget, pick a crown 亗, swords ⚔️, or wings ꧁ ꧂ and click Copy.
faq.q6: Is my text private and secure?
faq.a6: All text processing happens directly inside your web browser. We never store or transmit your personal text to any server.
